snippet.title: Path of Exile 1 | The Covens Gather | 3.30 Teaser
snippet.description:
She comes for your realm.

Find out everything about our next Path of Exile expansion on November 6 at 12:30 PM PST at twitch.tv/pathofexile

Play Path of Exile 1: Covens of Umbra for free on PC and consoles on November 13th PST.
